purpose: Protect verified progress from silent rewind, destructive redesign, or uncheckpointed changes to critical NayaPOWER execution surfaces.

baseline.meaning: Protected-progress checkpoint advanced to the commit that binds the Assistant Cloudflare Hub Release workflow to the protected checkpoint path, enabling the canonical release lane to execute from the current protected tree.

verification_receipt.workflow_run: NAYA 509 — Assistant Cloudflare Hub Release push trigger
verification_receipt.result: The Cloudflare release workflow now executes on changes to the canonical Hub, its workflow, or the protected progress checkpoint. It still deploys the exact canonical HTML artifact to worker sparkling-shape-7ae5 and independently curls the live runtime after deployment.
verification_receipt.first_divergence_repaired: The live Cloudflare worker remained on the old Hub while the canonical GitHub source had advanced. The release lane was only watching the canonical HTML and its own workflow, so the protected checkpoint repair could not itself trigger a release. The workflow path set is now bound to the checkpoint so the current protected tree can force a fresh canonical deployment without creating another Hub artifact.
verification_receipt.authorized_by: NAYA POWER repository authority / Shawn Vibert

protected_scope.rule: Changes to critical execution architecture require verification and a fresh checkpoint before the next protected change is accepted.

anti_rewind.rule: Current main HEAD must be a descendant of the checkpoint baseline. A rewind, force-push behind the baseline, or replacement history that loses the protected baseline fails closed.

checkpoint_protocol.step_1: Make the smallest necessary protected change.
checkpoint_protocol.step_2: Run the relevant tests and verification evidence.
checkpoint_protocol.step_3: If protected paths changed, create a new checkpoint whose baseline commit is the verified protected-change commit before another protected change is accepted.
checkpoint_protocol.step_4: Never advance a checkpoint merely because code exists. Verification evidence is required.
checkpoint_protocol.step_5: If evidence is unavailable, preserve UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and do not promote the checkpoint.
checkpoint_protocol.step_6: A cold Naya restores the checkpoint before modifying protected scope.

known_risks: GitHub rulesets/branch protection are not currently configured in the repository; this gate is a CI enforcement layer, not yet a server-side immutable branch rule.
A repository administrator can technically disable workflows or alter the checkpoint; repository authority remains an external boundary.
The Assistant Cloudflare/live production lane remains a separate runtime proof boundary and must not be substituted with the GitHub 509 lane.
unknowns: Fresh Protected Progress Gate acceptance after this checkpoint refresh is pending.
Fresh external LLM behavioral proof beyond repository-level cold-Naya acceptance remains unknown.
Fresh Cloudflare production deployment and live runtime proof are pending on the release triggered by this checkpoint commit.
next_action: Allow the checkpoint push to trigger NAYA 509 — Assistant Cloudflare Hub Release, then inspect the live worker and require exact canonical Smart Board runtime proof before declaring completion.
truth_rules: A newer commit is not automatically a better state
No checkpoint may erase or rewrite historical evidence
failure_behavior: FAIL CLOSED. Do not redesign, reset, restore from memory, or silently overwrite protected work. Identify the first divergence, preserve the evidence, and leave one executable repair action.
